certification.name: Certified Cyber Resilience Professional
certification.description: Credential combining cybersecurity and business continuity for resilience professionals. Requires more than two years of experience, essays on three of five elements (identify, protect, detect, respond, recover) and a pass of at least 75% on the Cyber Resilience Examination.
certification.currency_note: Application fee $400 and annual renewal fee $225; the Cyber Resilience Examination fee is not listed on the certification page
